reconcile.note: Gill treats Matthew's scarlet and Mark and John's purple as either overlapping shades of the same royal color or two garments worn in sequence.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible sets Matthew's scarlet robe against Mark's and John's purple as conflicting eyewitness details rather than compatible shades.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "What color was Jesus's robe?" (n.d.).

sides.snippet: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.
sides.verseText: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.

sides.snippet: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
sides.verseText: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.
